import json
# Re-check the CoachForce Market Research Report meeting transcript to verify all 7 participants provided concrete feedback
with open('DATA/products/CoachForce.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

for t in data['meeting_transcripts']:
    if t.get('id') == 'CoFoAIX_planning_1':
        content = t.get('transcript', '')
        # Show all speakers
        speakers = set()
        for line in content.split('\n'):
            if ':' in line:
                speaker = line.split(':')[0].strip()
                speakers.add(speaker)
        print('All speakers:', speakers)
        # Count their feedback turns
        for speaker in speakers:
            count = sum(1 for line in content.split('\n') if line.startswith(speaker + ':'))
            print(f'  {speaker}: {count} turns')
        break
